physicalEvidence.summary: The completeSeptember 2024 coaching paper runs SAC on a real Sawyer with an ultrasound probe and wrist force sensor, scanning two bladder phantoms. ResNet50-based image quality supplies the learning reward; sparse kinesthetic corrections update the policy through a separate coaching buffer. The script pauses motion for expert intervention, then resumes. Learned policies are evaluated in 10trials each. The paper explicitly says this work was primarily conducted at Purdue; it is not patient validation or current UTA platform access. Physical20. A 2026 VLA survey proves current research activity, not new physical execution.

physicalEvidence.status: Prior-host learned robot verified; current-site access unverified
physicalEvidence.summary: The complete 2022 RA-L paper validates meta-learned state/uncertainty prediction on an actual AscTec Hummingbird with ROS and Vicon. Pitch-command biases emulate faults; the motors are not physically damaged. Predicted collision risk triggers sampled-waypoint replanning over a baseline PID flight controller. Disabled-replanning tests fly above the obstacle to avoid damaging the UAV, rather than intentionally crashing it. These are prior UVA/Stanford-era experiments, not new RPI hardware. Physical18 reflects older controlled-lab evidence; current 2026 belief-space planning publications do not establish a fresh physical deployment.
